description: Source code for the LIS2DE12 accelerometer sensor driver, including interrupt handling, trigger setup, and GPIO configuration.

methods.name: lis2de12_enable_xl_int
methods.description: Enables or disables the accelerometer interrupt pin.

methods.name: lis2de12_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets external trigger for data ready event.

methods.name: lis2de12_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles the data ready interrupt, reads status, and calls handler if registered.

methods.name: lis2de12_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback for interrupt, disables GPIO and signals thread.

methods.name: lis2de12_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling interrupts if configured.

methods.name: lis2de12_work_cb
methods.description: Work callback for handling interrupts if configured.

methods.name: lis2de12_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO and interrupt configuration for the sensor.
